summary: The reviewed commit is pushed to its configured upstream and contains the named v5.7.1 production code, tests, profile, checkpoint, and validation report. However, release acceptance is blocked: the audit framework and current audit run are untracked, the worktree is dirty, no gate decision exists for this run, test assertions lack reviewed-commit provenance, referenced pilot evidence is ignored and unarchived, and there is no annotated v5.7.1 release tag.

evidence: Command `git branch --show-current; git rev-parse HEAD` returned `feature/v5.7.1-annotation-tolerant-unet` and `d8c498ca3c76b17ce76c02dc85bed5d9ac542d0b`.
Command `git branch -vv` showed HEAD tracking `origin/feature/v5.7.1-annotation-tolerant-unet` at the same commit.
Command `git remote -v` identified `origin` as `https://github.com/dushyant-mishra/Drosophila-sperm-nuclei-segmentation.git` for fetch and push.
Command `git rev-list --left-right --count main...HEAD` returned `0 10`; the reviewed branch is ten commits ahead of local main.
`git status --porcelain=v2` reports modified `PROJECT_LAYOUT.md` and `sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.py`.
The same status reports untracked `AGENTS.md`, `audits/`, `scripts/run_multi_agent_audit.ps1`, `scripts/validate_agent_audit.py`, and `tests/test_agent_audit_framework.py`.
`git diff --stat` reports eight changed lines in `PROJECT_LAYOUT.md`; `sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.py` is also marked modified but yields no textual diff, with line-ending warnings.
audits/runs/20260821-v571-production-diagnostic/manifest.json:7-17 explicitly records a dirty pre-commit audit and the untracked audit files.

`git ls-tree -r --name-only HEAD` confirmed the reviewed commit contains `sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py`, `utils/tune_parameters_Saturnv5_7_1.py`, `utils/saturn_unet25d_bridge.py`, `production_profiles/saturn_v5_7_1_model_c_epoch003.json`, `model_checkpoints/v571_model_c_dual_head_epoch003.pt`, both named v5.7.1 test files, and `V5_7_1_VALIDATION_REPORT.md`.
V5_7_1_VALIDATION_REPORT.md:7-11 names the same pipeline, tuner, profile, checkpoint, and checkpoint SHA-256 as the claim.

production_profiles/saturn_v5_7_1_model_c_epoch003.json:30-32 names the checkpoint and expected SHA-256; `certutil -hashfile model_checkpoints\v571_model_c_dual_head_epoch003.pt SHA256` returned the matching digest `7d49031dbcce31f0600c44146d9b5282b0df6e28bb1fc1bdde6ef2146ed15d25`.

production_profiles/saturn_v5_7_1_model_c_epoch003.json:209-221 identifies pipeline version `v5.7.1-dual-head-width`, the shared tracking mode, production-selection status, and notes `metadata_validation_passed` is false.
sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:4592 and utils/tune_parameters_Saturnv5_7_1.py:36 both identify `v5.7.1-body-width`.

`rg --files audits | rg 'decision|gate_summary|reviews'` found no gate summary, decision, or review under `audits/runs/20260821-v571-production-diagnostic`; only the generic `audits/decision_template.json` and prior smoke-run outputs exist.
audits/runs/20260821-v571-production-diagnostic/manifest.json:28-31 has `completed_at_utc: null` and an empty `role_exit_codes` object.

audits/README.md:88-96 requires a clean identified commit, accepted or deferred high-risk claims, passing test and audit validation, exact profile/checkpoint identity, repository steward verdict, and explicit authorization.
The claim registry and audit run are untracked according to `git status --porcelain=v2`, so the reviewed commit cannot recover the claim or its eventual decision.

V5_7_1_VALIDATION_REPORT.md:92-97 states compilation passed, `179 passed in 23.45s`, tuner self-check passed, and `git diff --check` passed, but it records no Git commit, command transcript, environment manifest, or immutable test artifact linking those results to d8c498ca3c76b17ce76c02dc85bed5d9ac542d0b.

Focused command `.\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests\test_saturn_v571_dual_head.py tests\test_saturn_v571_body_width.py` could not start because the read-only environment had no usable temporary directory; therefore this review did not independently reproduce the tests.

Current `git diff --check` completed with line-ending warnings for `PROJECT_LAYOUT.md` and `sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.py`, but it was run in the dirty pre-commit tree rather than an isolated checkout of the reviewed commit.

Command `.\.venv\Scripts\python.exe scripts\validate_agent_audit.py --run audits\runs\20260821-v571-production-diagnostic` failed with `PermissionError` while attempting to create `gate_summary.json`.
No `audits/runs/20260821-v571-production-diagnostic/gate_summary.json` exists.
audits/runs/20260821-v571-production-diagnostic/manifest.json:28-31 confirms the run remains incomplete.
`.gitignore:15-23` excludes logs, TIFFs, PNGs, backups, batch launchers, and ZIP archives.
.gitignore:25-45 excludes batch outputs, result directories, scratch data, private configuration, unblinding material, tuning panels, tuning results, and v5.7/v5.7.1 tuning outputs.

V5_7_1_VALIDATION_REPORT.md:35-36 cites tuning artifacts under `parameter_tuning_results_v5_7_1/mixed_tracking/shared`, while `.gitignore:45` excludes v5.7.1 settings and the repository status provides no immutable archive manifest for those artifacts.

V5_7_1_VALIDATION_REPORT.md:54-82 bases the full-specimen pilot and visual/report assertions on `scratch/v571_final_production_pilot`; `.gitignore:29` excludes all `scratch/`, so these cited reports and source tables are not recoverable from the reviewed commit.
A tracked-file size scan found the intended 4,634,914-byte checkpoint plus several pre-existing large DOCX/PNG/archive artifacts; no new accidental generated data was established for this commit.
A focused `git grep` over HEAD for common API-key, GitHub-token, private-key, and assigned-password patterns returned no matches.
The committed `.gitignore` explicitly excludes `gemini_api_key.txt` under its `# Secrets` section.
This was a pattern-based scan, not a complete entropy or history scan.
`git for-each-ref` shows the reviewed branch aligned with its configured upstream at d8c498ca3c76b17ce76c02dc85bed5d9ac542d0b.
The same command shows local `feature/v5.7.1-body-width` at 1600a39fb84f5ba357b29fabaf81432bacfd3a34 with no upstream.

`git merge-base --is-ancestor 1600a39 HEAD` exited successfully, and `git rev-list --left-right --count feature/v5.7.1-body-width...HEAD` returned `0 9`; this side branch is fully incorporated into HEAD but remains as a local stale branch.
Remote equality is based on local remote-tracking refs; network refresh was unavailable, so current server state was not independently fetched.
`git tag --points-at HEAD` returned no tag for the reviewed commit.
`git show-ref --tags` lists only `v5.7.0`; `git cat-file -t v5.7.0` returned `tag`, confirming that older tag is annotated.
No annotated v5.7.1 tag, release decision, immutable audit archive, or archived hashes for the ignored pilot/tuning evidence were found.
audits/README.md:88-96 defines release prerequisites that are not yet satisfied.
sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:47 describes the software as a `production-ready image-analysis pipeline`.
production_profiles/saturn_v5_7_1_model_c_epoch003.json:31 and V5_7_1_VALIDATION_REPORT.md:5 correctly use the narrower term `production candidate`.

V5_7_1_VALIDATION_REPORT.md:101-105 says the candidate is ready for a controlled full-study run and retains a below-2-um sensitivity requirement; however, this readiness statement is not backed by a completed, committed audit gate.
production_profiles/saturn_v5_7_1_model_c_epoch003.json:220 explicitly records `metadata_validation_passed: false`, which conflicts with unqualified production-ready wording.

findings.title: Current high-risk audit and decision are not recoverable from Git
findings.impact: The reviewed commit cannot reproduce the claim registry, audit rules, review run, or acceptance decision. The repository release gate therefore cannot accept or later reconstruct this production candidate.
evidence: `git status --porcelain=v2` identifies `audits/`, `AGENTS.md`, both audit scripts, and the audit-framework test as untracked.
audits/runs/20260821-v571-production-diagnostic/manifest.json:28-31 shows an incomplete run with no role exit codes.
No gate summary or decision exists under `audits/runs/20260821-v571-production-diagnostic`.
audits/README.md:88-96 requires completed audit evidence before production release.
findings.recommendation: After all independent reviews complete, create a superseding audit run on a clean commit containing the audit framework and claim registry. Commit the append-only reviews and gate decision through the authorized release workflow.

findings.title: Validation commands are not proven to have run on the reviewed commit
findings.impact: The report's passing-test assertions cannot be attributed immutably to d8c498ca3c76b17ce76c02dc85bed5d9ac542d0b, and the audit gate has not completed.
evidence: V5_7_1_VALIDATION_REPORT.md:92-97 contains summary assertions but no commit hash or immutable command log.
The focused pytest attempt in this review failed before collection because no writable temporary directory was available.
The audit validator failed with `PermissionError`, and no gate summary was produced.
findings.recommendation: Run compilation, the complete documented test suite, tuner self-check, `git diff --check`, and audit validation from a clean checkout of the exact candidate commit. Archive command, exit status, environment, commit, and output hashes.

findings.title: Pilot and tuning evidence cited by the validation report is ignored and unarchived
findings.impact: Key full-specimen counts, report agreement, render quality, tracking replay, and parameter-selection evidence cannot be recovered from Git or independently checked later.
evidence: V5_7_1_VALIDATION_REPORT.md:35-36 cites v5.7.1 tuning artifacts.
V5_7_1_VALIDATION_REPORT.md:54-82 cites the ignored `scratch/v571_final_production_pilot` tree and its PDF reports.
`.gitignore:25-45` excludes these generated analysis and tuning locations.
No immutable evidence archive or artifact manifest was found for the reviewed version.
findings.recommendation: Archive the minimum raw/derived evidence needed for verification in an immutable approved location, record content hashes and provenance in the release manifest, and keep sensitive/raw microscopy data separate as policy requires.

findings.title: No annotated v5.7.1 release tag exists
findings.impact: There is no immutable named release pointer tying code, profile, checkpoint, documentation, tests, and audit decision together.
evidence: `git tag --points-at HEAD` returned no tag.
`git show-ref --tags` returned only v5.7.0.
The existing v5.7.0 reference is annotated, as `git cat-file -t v5.7.0` returned `tag`.
findings.recommendation: Only after the audit gate passes and explicit authorization is obtained, create and publish an annotated v5.7.1 tag referencing the accepted commit and immutable evidence manifest.

findings.title: Release wording exceeds the completed validation state
findings.impact: Users may interpret the code as generally production-ready despite an incomplete audit, missing immutable evidence, and an explicitly false metadata-validation field.
evidence: sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:47 says `production-ready image-analysis pipeline`.
production_profiles/saturn_v5_7_1_model_c_epoch003.json:220 records `metadata_validation_passed: false`.
V5_7_1_VALIDATION_REPORT.md:101-105 limits readiness to a controlled full-study run and requires separate below-2-um sensitivity reporting.
No completed audit decision exists for this run.
findings.recommendation: Use production-candidate or controlled-study wording until the gate passes, and explicitly disclose incomplete metadata validation and the remaining sensitivity review.

findings.title: Dirty pre-commit state prevents a clean release snapshot
findings.impact: The reviewed commit differs from the active filesystem, making commands run in the current tree ambiguous and risking accidental inclusion or omission during release preparation.
evidence: audits/runs/20260821-v571-production-diagnostic/manifest.json:7-17 records the dirty tree.
`git status --porcelain=v2` reports two modified tracked files and multiple untracked audit files.
`git diff --check` emits line-ending warnings for both modified tracked files.
findings.recommendation: Resolve intended changes through the authorized commit workflow, then rerun the entire acceptance audit against a clean commit.

findings.title: Integrated local side branch lacks upstream and remains stale
findings.impact: The branch can confuse release provenance and future maintenance, although it does not itself alter the candidate commit.
evidence: `git for-each-ref` shows `feature/v5.7.1-body-width` without an upstream.
`git merge-base --is-ancestor 1600a39 HEAD` succeeded.
`git rev-list --left-right --count feature/v5.7.1-body-width...HEAD` returned `0 9`.
findings.recommendation: Document the branch as integrated. Any later branch cleanup requires explicit authorization and is not part of this review.

limitations: No other reviewers' outputs were read.
No full image stack was run.
Focused pytest could not start because the read-only environment provided no writable temporary directory.
The audit validator writes `gate_summary.json`; it could not complete under read-only permissions.
Remote synchronization was assessed from local remote-tracking refs without a network fetch.
The secret scan used focused signatures and did not inspect complete Git history or perform entropy analysis.
Permission-denied ignored scratch directories prevented exhaustive enumeration of local generated artifacts.
recommended_follow_up: Commit the audit framework and claim registry through an authorized change, then create a clean superseding audit run.
Complete every required independent review and generate a passing gate decision for the exact clean commit.
Run and archive all validation commands with commit and environment provenance.
Archive hashed pilot, tuning, report, and checkpoint evidence in an immutable approved location.
Correct release wording until metadata validation and the audit gate pass.
After explicit authorization, publish the accepted commit and create an annotated v5.7.1 tag.
